== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (Japanese)|Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/147361100/w-SOSlISs0iCF68BAx-HOA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 80497042.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>aefaee9eeb41814280ba4e728b135771ab839d21346ac7434a930528b8cf684a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
